profile_text.body:
Synopsys Inc. describes itself as delivering comprehensive silicon-to-systems solutions that help innovators accelerate development, reduce risk, and drive breakthroughs. Its website identifies the company with EDA tools, semiconductor IP, and systems verification. A recent site headline says Synopsys is advancing power and performance for AI and multi-die designs on the latest Samsung Foundry processes, presented at SAFE Forum 2026.

The company is a public company headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, trading under the ticker SNPS. SEC records list it under CIK 0000883241. California public records show 281 legal exposure entries associated with the company. Its website includes an AI-powered chatbot that provides general information about products and services, with a notice that responses may be incorrect or incomplete and that chats may be accessed by Synopsys and its service providers.
